# ARR Bridge

Years 1-5 at both price scenarios, capacity-ramped. Growth is arithmetic (logos x ACV), not a compound-rate assumption dressed up as a plan.

| 1 | 3-5 | 0.0-0.1 | - | 3-5 | 0.3-0.5 | - |
| 2 | 10-16 | 0.1-0.2 | 3.20x | 10-16 | 1.0-1.7 | 3.20x |

| 4 | 25-41 | 0.3-0.5 | 1.33x | 25-41 | 2.6-4.2 | 1.33x |

## Reading this table honestly

The two columns are not two growth rates. They are the **same customers** at two prices. Every rupee of difference between the Scenario A and Scenario B columns is attributable to a price assumption, not to additional selling effort, additional market, or additional customers.

That is the most important sentence in this document, and it is why Scenario A is the base case.

## Plus the state layer

Adding G9 at its PRIOR band contributes Rs 0.8-6.4 crore, arriving years 3-8 and not before. It is reported separately rather than folded into the bridge, because folding a PRIOR into a SIMULATED would produce a single number with two incompatible evidence grades.

## What this bridge deliberately does not do

- It does not assume net revenue retention above 100%. No usage data exists.
- It does not assume any logo churn. No cohort exists to churn.
- It does not model pricing escalation. No contract has been renewed.
- It does not model the state layer before year 3.
